name: Takeda Kojuurou
source:
Kojuurou is [url=/c16780]Ageha's[/url] butler. Despite getting hit by her often he does not mind; as a matter of fact, he finds great displeasure in receiving any other form of punishment or praise. While strong and hardworking, he tends to be a blockhead.

[Based on [url=https://en.m.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Kimi_ga_Aruji_de_Shitsuji_ga_Ore_de&diffonly=true]Wikipedia[/url]]
